note: F1a: every role="alert" (and role={...'alert'...}, aria-live="assertive") under app/ and components/, NOS chrome (components/nos-chrome/) excluded, is class (a) unless listed here. (a) = error summary or page-level error: border-2 border-[var(--status-error)], aria-hidden icon, status-error text, no background tint. (b) = field-level alert of a named allowed kind. (c) = not an error (a status notice). Each entry names a file and a substring that must appear in the alert's opening tag or the 300 characters before it; an entry matching no alert FAILS the check (stale). New alerts default to (a).

classes.reason: TicketFieldAlert: the left-border-only field alert (border-l-2 border-error, bg-transparent, aria-hidden warning sign, error text). Golden-compliant for field errors.
Footer newsletter topics field error: left-border-only field alert (or its sr-only mirror for screen readers) tied to the fieldset by aria-describedby.
Admin settings inline field-level error with an aria-hidden icon and the error text colour; not a page-level summary.
